screen.eldencraft_bridge.enchanting.intr: Find whetblades in Elden Ring to unlock status infusions.
screen.eldencraft_bridge.enchanting.help:
Enchantments in the Lands Between
Sharpness: stronger hits.
Looting: more runes from kills.
Unbreaking: less durability wear.
Protection: less incoming damage.
Black Whetblade unlocks Poison and Blood Loss.
Glintstone Whetblade unlocks Frostbite.
Hits build status until the target's resistance is overcome.
A weapon can carry one status affinity.
Shields take guard enchantments, such as Guarding Ability, Healing and Explosive, with no whetblade needed.
Infusions use lapis and experience. Hover an offer to read its effect.
screen.eldencraft_bridge.enchanting.one_: One status affinity per weapon. Hover offers for effect details.
